thread:
carla_acme: Hey @support, one of our org admins (me) sees 403 when opening org settings in the console after our IdP team did an attribute sanitization deploy overnight. Error in the UI: "403 permission_denied: missing org.admin role". Worked yesterday.

sam_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the full error payload or screenshot? did you try sign-out/sign-in?

carla_acme: Here's the UI error modal text, and we tried sign-out but still 403. We have multiple admins affected. No recent user removal on our side.

sam_support: Thanks. Can you confirm whether you logged in before or after the IdP change? Also send the user email(s) so I can look up their session and assertion logs.

carla_acme: I logged in before the change and left the tab open. Emails: carla@acme.example, tom@acme.example.

jess_prodeng: Quick hypothesis: our IdP attribute sanitization removed/normalized the `roles` SAML claim for some assertions. If a user has a session created before the claim changed, the session cookie might still contain the old claims set that no longer maps to org.admin.

mike_sre: Repro notes from our side: start a session, then push IdP attribute normalization job. Existing sessions do not get full re-evaluated claims until re-auth. System logs show 200 on assertion exchange but a mismatch in mapped roles.

idp-bot: SCIM sync job completed for acme.example (job id 9f3c) — changes: attribute_sanitization=v1.2 at 2024-11-28T03:12:08Z.

sam_support: Root-cause likely stale session + attribute rename. Short-term fix: ask affected users to fully sign out and clear site session (or use an incognito window) and sign back in so the new assertion is applied. If org admins still blocked, we can do a forced session invalidation for those accounts.

carla_acme: Signing out + incognito worked for one user, but several still report 403 after fresh sign-in. Any further steps?

jess_prodeng: For those, we need to check two things: (1) the IdP assertion payload at login to ensure the roles claim contains the expected org-admin membership, (2) our mapping rule for attribute sanitization didn't rename the claim key (e.g., `roles` -> `role_list`) without adding an alias. If the claim key changed, our mapping won't populate the org role. Can you share a redacted assertion (replace tokens) for an affected user?

carla_acme: Pasted redacted SAML assertion in thread (replaced real values). It shows claim `role_list: ["OrgAdmin"]` and no `roles` key.

mike_sre: That matches the mapping mismatch. Short term workaround from our side: we can create an alias mapping so `role_list` maps to internal `roles` for your org, or you can reconfigure IdP to also emit `roles`.

sam_support: Operationally, two remediation options: 
- If you want immediate access restored, we can run a one-off mapping alias for your org: `POST /internal/orgs/{org_id}/attribute-mappings` with body `{"alias": "role_list", "target": "roles"}` (we'll run this manually; we will not ask you to expose secrets).
- Or coordinate with your IdP team to add the legacy `roles` claim back and have users re-login.

carla_acme: We prefer the alias for now so we don't have to change IdP. Please go ahead. Also any audit implications?

mike_sre: Alias will be logged and restricted to your org. We'll add an audit record and send the change details.

sam_support: I've queued the alias change with eng oncall. ETA ~20–30m. I'll post back when done. :thumbsup:

idp-bot: Audit event created: alias_mapping.create by sam_support for org acme.example at 2024-11-28T03:45:12Z (id a1b2).

sam_support: Update — eng applied the mapping, and I invalidated active sessions for the two emails you sent. Can you confirm you can open org settings now?

carla_acme: Confirmed — org settings accessible again for all affected admins. Thanks so much.

jess_prodeng: We'll follow up with a postmortem note to your IdP contact recommending a stable claim name policy and a phased rollout that includes an aliasing window to avoid breakage.

carla_acme: Appreciated. Please send the audit log copy and any suggested IdP config lines.

sam_support: Will do — adding ticket #SUP-94231 and we will attach logs and recommended IdP mapping snippet. Closing here once you acknowledge receipt of artifacts.

carla_acme: Got it, received artifacts. Closing from our side. Thanks again!
